note: spaces toolbar -- platform's own interface for navigation between mail, address book, calendar, tasks, chat, settings
unified toolbar container -- platform's own interface including unified toolbar, notification box, appmenu, and window titlebar controls
main menubar -- platform's own interface with File, Edit, View, Go, message, tasks, help menus
folder pane header bar -- platform's own controls for more actions, writing messages, and getting messages
thread pane header bar -- platform's own controls for folder name, quick filter, and display options
message header toolbox -- platform's own controls for reply, forward, archive, junk, trash, other actions, and star message
compose toolbar -- platform's own controls for send, encryption, spelling, save, contacts, and attach
format toolbar -- platform's own controls for paragraph style, font face, font size, bold, italic, underline, lists, alignment, and insertions
status bar -- platform's own interface for offline status and status text
